commonTask: 请把这份分析整理成可供组会使用的简短结果说明。我们要据此决定，当前实现能否作为后续比较基线。限于给定材料和已有 CPU 工具，交付可采用的结论及依据。
checkpointInstruction: 当前是已批准短流程的初始部分。先对 v1 做必要核查，返回临时事实、输入版本、实际命令与结果及未决项后结束本次回合。后续采用决定将在预定交接中完成；临时返回不代表整个任务已验收。
releaseInstruction: 当前采用决定应针对 v2。v1 原件及既有结果保留。按当前批准继续完成原决定。先核对真实 context、原 run 与 checkpoint 身份；不要再次 begin。

guidanceSelection.meaning: Complete selected baseline/candidate authoring section plus the same complete existing judgment reference; candidate additionally receives the complete outcome reference. Full-file and selected-text hashes are distinct.

reserve: At most one diagnosed complete affected pair: D adds2 or W adds4; never chase positive outcomes.
limitations: Explicit material delivery, not cognitive uptake or natural conditional-loading activation; parent unblinded, one pair per case, inherited native configuration, no significance/general efficacy inference.
